content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Gumroad payhip

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is a complete, self-owned digital sales stack. It combines free and paid tools to create a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. Unlike Gumroad or Payhip, which rely on Stripe or PayPal for payments, this system uses NOWPayments—a non-custodial crypto payment gateway with 0.5% fees and no KYC requirements. The backend runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, order data is stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, and files are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Hosting is handled by GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. The entire stack is deployed under your control, with no third-party dependencies. This means you’re not renting a platform—you’re owning your infrastructure. It’s built to operate in regions where conventional payment processors are unavailable, giving you permanent access to global markets.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture is modular and decentralized. Here’s how it works: Your storefront is hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, both of which are free and globally distributed. Backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which process orders and trigger actions. Order data is stored in Supabase (a scalable, open-source alternative to Firebase) or Google Sheets for simplicity. Product files are stored in Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring fast and reliable delivery. Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and automatically verifies transactions on-chain. Once payment is confirmed, a webhook triggers the delivery of the digital product to the customer. The entire system is designed to be lightweight, cost-effective, and fully automated. You deploy it once, and it runs without ongoing fees or platform restrictions.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This system is built for digital creators in countries where Stripe, PayPal, and other payment processors are unavailable or severely restricted. If you’re in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, or similar regions, this is for you. You sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, software, or other digital products but cannot collect payment through conventional platforms. This infrastructure gives you a permanent alternative. It’s not a temporary fix—it’s a structural solution. You own the entire stack, from hosting to payment processing. There are no subscriptions, no platform fees, and no risk of being locked out. It’s designed to operate in the most challenging environments, ensuring you can sell your products globally without relying on third-party platforms that exclude you.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you full ownership of your sales stack—no platforms, no subscriptions.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack consists of carefully selected components that work together seamlessly. Hosting is handled by GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, both of which are free and globally distributed. Backend logic is managed by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, depending on your needs. Order storage is handled by Supabase or Google Sheets, ensuring scalability and simplicity. File delivery is managed by Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, both of which are reliable and cost-effective. Payments are processed by NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and charges a flat 0.5% fee. The system is designed to be modular, so you can swap components as needed. For example, if you prefer a simpler setup, you can use Google Sheets for order storage instead of Supabase. The key is that every component is under your control, with no dependencies on platforms that exclude you.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this system, start by choosing the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) from COREMERCH. This stack includes Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto payments. It comes with SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration, end-to-end testing, and 30-day support. Once purchased, the stack is deployed within 48 hours, with 5 products pre-loaded. You’ll receive full access to the codebase and documentation, allowing you to customize and scale as needed. If you prefer to deploy it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint ($47) provides complete documentation, source code, and a NOWPayments integration guide. Either way, you’ll own the entire stack, with no ongoing fees or platform dependencies. This is how you build a sovereign commerce infrastructure that works anywhere, for anyone.

Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this system if I’m not technical?

Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack is deployed for you, with 5 products pre-loaded and full support. If you prefer to deploy it yourself, the Sovereign Blueprint includes complete documentation and source code.
What cryptocurrencies are supported?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Binance Coin, and stablecoins like USDT. Recommended networks for low fees are BSC, Solana, and TRON.
How much does it cost to run this system?
Hosting, backend logic, and order storage are free. NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee per transaction. There are no platform fees or subscriptions.
Can I customize the storefront?
Yes. The codebase is fully accessible, allowing you to customize the storefront, backend logic, and product delivery process.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments is non-custodial, meaning you retain control of your funds. If it goes down, you can switch to another crypto payment gateway using the same infrastructure.
